description:
iPhone is the most popular camera in the world, with billions of photos taken every year! The detailed integration of software and hardware has led to features like Smart HDR, Portrait Mode, Night Mode, Photonic Engine, and Action Mode, which deliver magical experiences that surprise and delight our customers.
The Camera Technologies & Systems team in Camera Software team delivers amazing quality photos and videos by combining state-of-the-art computer vision, image processing, and machine learning.

Description
The Camera Technologies team is looking for an enthusiastic and talented software engineer with a technical background in camera imaging. In this role you will be responsible for prototyping, developing, and integrating cutting-edge camera and imaging technologies into our cameras. Our team works with complex systems and many diverse teams to develop cutting-edge software which continually enhances our camera and photos solutions.

Responsibilities
As an engineer on our team you'll develop and extend those software pipelines, working side-by-side with the exceptional engineers who made iPhone’s camera what it is today, and build new extraordinary camera capabilities spanning the universe of Apple devices. Whenever you see a “Shot on iPhone” billboard, you see our work; it could be your work, too!

Minimum qualifications
3+ years of software development and camera system experience.
Excellent coding skills in C or C++.
Strong technical background in image and video processing and computational photography.
Knowledge and experience using Computer Vision to solve real-world problems.
Previous experience in digital imaging and camera development.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative and solve problems without explicit direction.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
MS or PhD in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications
Familiarity with common development and debugging tools for embedded/mobile applications.
Familiarity with camera systems and ISP processing pipeline.
Motion sensor processing and fusion experience
